text:
lucy: Noticed a usability problem on narrow Android devices (360w) in Task Runs table — when the sidebar collapses to icons the row action chevrons get pushed under the rail and tapping the ellipsis often opens the sidebar.

omar: ugh. repro steps? device+browser?

lucy: Pixel 4a, Chrome stable. Steps: Console > Projects > Runs tab > narrow width, try to open row menu. Screen recording: https://redwood-internal/screencaptures/pixel4a-runmenu.mp4

rachel: I think this started after we added the compact list mode. The rows are 44px high but the rail z-index is higher than the table layer.

kevin: quick fix: lower sidebar z-index under table rows at <= 380px and make icon rail hit targets 44px. But long-term we should consider an accessible fallback: move per-row actions into a single overflow that opens centered, or convert them into an inline expandable row.

lucy: design options in figma: https://www.figma.com/file/XyZ/console-compact-list — proposals: "inline expand" (expands row to show actions), "centered popover" (kebab opens centered popover above row), or "drawer" (full-screen on narrow).

omar: my vote is centered popover — keeps context and avoids trap/focus issues with full-screen drawer. Also easier for QA.

rachel: accessibility nit: if we use popover ensure it is modal for screen readers and announced as "Menu for run <id>". Also provide keyboard-only affordances: three-keyboard-focus order should move into the popover.

kevin: dev note: adding this CSS snippet fixes the immediate overlap for prototyping:
```css
@media (max-width: 380px) {
  .app-sidebar { z-index: 10; }
  .runs-table { z-index: 20; }
  .row .action-button { min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; padding: 6px; }
}
```

rachel: can we also reduce the left rail icon size at small widths to avoid occluding content? Maybe 20px icons with 8px surrounding padding.

lucy: Also found copy issue on narrow: the "Retry" button label wraps to two lines and looks weird. Suggest short label "Retry" -> keep but change spacing, or icon-only with tooltip on focus.

omar: prefer icon+sr-only label for space-limited contexts. Will add aria-label="Retry run" and keep visible text offscreen for screen readers.

lucy: QA request: add Percy snapshots at 360/375/412 widths for Runs table and add a Cypress e2e test that simulates keyboard navigation opening the popover.

dev-bot: Percy snapshot queued: builds/5921/runs-table-360.png ✅

kevin: I'll raise a quick PR with the z-index + hit-target changes and a centered popover prototype. Tagging @rachel for a11y review.

rachel: will check a11y in the morning. Remember Esc closes popover and focus returns to the kebab. Also test TalkBack/VoiceOver.

lucy: thanks team — filing follow-up tasks in the design board and adding links to the PR.

kevin: assigning code review to @omar. :thumbsup:
